name: Michael Feleke Sahle
introduction: I’m interested in how mathematics and artificial intelligence can help solve practical problems in Ethiopia. I’ve worked on an agriculture toolkit that uses machine learning and environmental sensors, and on a mobile finance app that organizes transactions from bank SMS alerts.

I also co-founded my school’s chess club, served as debate club secretary and helped organize local outreach. I enjoy exploring ideas with other students, whether we’re working through a math problem or preparing for a debate.

activities.commitment: During school and breaks · 10 hr/week · 12 weeks/year
highlights: Led my team at one of Ethiopia’s 40 STEAM centers in designing an IoT system that recommends crops and detects plant diseases for Ethiopian farmers. The project earned first place at the engineering fair.

activities.commitment: During school and breaks · 10 hr/week · 10 weeks/year
highlights: Led my team in designing a structure that kept an egg intact after a drop from 30 km. The project won an international award for creative problem-solving and innovative design.

activities.commitment: During school and breaks · 3 hr/week · 17 weeks/year
highlights: Organized friends and neighbors through a local initiative with more than 50 active members. We raised over 20,000 birr and collected books for local children, helped more than 150 people and earned recognition from local administrators.
Organized weekly chess meetings for more than 20 members, coached beginners and hosted a schoolwide tournament with more than 50 participants.
Led the board in organizing and running the school government election.

activities.commitment: During school and breaks · 3 hr/week · 13 weeks/year
highlights: Shared weekly science facts, organized school tournaments and helped students develop their ideas and projects through the school’s oldest club, which had more than 250 active members.
Coordinated a schoolwide debate with more than 30 participants. Helped lead my team to victory by developing arguments and mentoring teammates.

activities.commitment: During school and breaks · 4 hr/week · 24 weeks/year
highlights: Helped the team collect about US$1,000 worth of food for children and other community members who couldn’t afford it.

activities.commitment: During school and breaks · 3 hr/week · 27 weeks/year
highlights: Completed an advanced combinatorics course for students who performed well in national mathematics olympiads.
Took a piano course at a local music and theology school and developed a love for classical music.
Build full-stack websites, working across frontend and backend development.
